before_metrics.comment: exp-20260601-007 incidental lead: 5d winners continue over 10d (top quintile +1.34pct/10d, 3/3 windows, t=2.15), flagged not-promoted for 4 reasons. This pre-registered follow-up tests long-only excess and incrementality over core 20d momentum.

change_summary: Pre-registered (f5/h10, selection inherited from exp-007) long-only test on the broad 1446-ticker universe: top-quintile of 5d-formation winners, 10d skip-day hold, excess over universe equal-weight mean, with a ret20 double-sort incrementality test and one-round-trip (0.35pct) cost. Result: the long-only excess is real (+0.82pct gross / +0.47pct net per 10d, t=2.82, 3/3 windows -- clears even the 6-cell Bonferroni floor 2.64). But the ret20 double-sort residual (5d top-minus-bottom within ret20 bands) is +0.47pct point estimate with t=1.00 -- NOT significant. After controlling for core 20-day momentum the short-formation-specific component is indistinguishable from zero. The continuation is a genuine long-only momentum tilt but is NOT shown incremental over core momentum; most plausibly the same momentum at a correlated shorter horizon. NOTE: the first run's judge accepted incrementality on the residual point estimate alone; it was corrected to require the residual t>=2, flipping accept -> observed_only.
decision_rule: Accept only if (a) long-only top-quintile excess over universe mean net of one round trip (0.35pct) > 0 with majority-positive windows AND (b) the ret20 double-sort residual ret5 top-minus-bottom > one round trip AND significant (t>=2). A positive residual point estimate with insignificant t does NOT establish incrementality. If (a) holds but (b) fails -> continuation_not_incremental_over_ret20. Else no_long_only_excess. Excess t-stat inherits exp-007 multiple-testing debt; the ret20 residual significance is load-bearing.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: Is the long-only 5d-winner top quintile excess over the universe mean incremental over core 20-day momentum?
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260601-007 (reversal rejected, continuation incidental); exp-20260601-006 (broad-universe momentum weak); exp-20260601-003 (component decomposition).
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: ret5 top-quintile 10d excess return, controlled for ret20 via double-sort.
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: long-only net excess > 0 majority windows AND ret20 double-sort residual > cost AND t>=2.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Deterministic: warehouse all_windows_full_liquid, ret5/ret20/skip-day-10d, quintile + ret20 double-sort, t-stats. 5 unit tests including the residual-significance gate fix.

hypothesis: Confirmatory refinement of the exp-20260601-007 incidental lead: a long-only top-quintile of 5-day-formation winners held 10 trading days (skip-day) earns positive excess over the broad-universe equal-weight mean net of one round-trip cost in a majority of windows; the decisive new test is incrementality over core momentum (ret20 double-sort). f5/h10 selection inherited from exp-007 carries multiple-testing debt, so the per-day excess t-stat is reported but not treated as independent confirmation.
next_evidence_needed: Do not promote 5d-continuation as a distinct edge: not shown incremental over core 20d momentum (ret20 residual t=1.00). The long-only top-quintile momentum tilt itself (t=2.82, 3/3 windows) is real but overlaps the core momentum entry. A genuinely useful follow-up is a direct replacement-value test versus the actual same-day core candidates (not a ret20 proxy): does the top-quintile name beat the specific core candidate it would displace? That needs the core candidate set per day on the broad universe. True confirmation needs forward / out-of-sample data (3 windows are one contiguous 18-month period; f5/h10 selected from exp-007 grid).

prediction.outcome_vs_prediction: matched: continuation_collapses_after_ret20_control. Long-only excess real (t=2.82, 3/3 windows) but ret20-incremental residual insignificant (t=1.00).
